page_title: Free App to Free Up Storage on Mac (Open Source) | Tidymint

sources.entry: Tidymint - Open-source disk cleaner that only moves items to the Trash and checks whether your project scripts still reference a duplicate before removing it. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/HaiTrung-Workspace/tidymint) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Tidymint
summary.one_liner: Tidymint is a free, open-source Mac cleaner that shows what fills your disk, clears caches, finds duplicates, and fully uninstalls apps, moving everything to the Trash first with one-click Undo.
use_cases: free up disk space on a Mac
find out what is filling System Data
uninstall an app and its leftover files
remove duplicate files without breaking project scripts
clean browser and chat app caches
find large forgotten files on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: Tidymint scans a Mac for caches, logs, old installers and large files, grouping them by size with plain-language explanations; nothing is removed until the user confirms. Its uninstaller also finds caches, preferences and support files left after an app is removed. A disk map (Space Lens) shows which folders take up space, and Large Files lists items over 100 MB. The Duplicates tool matches files by content, keeps one copy, and flags copies referenced by scripts in user-added project folders. Every clean is recorded and can be undone while items remain in the Trash.
notable: Open source under MIT licence, with source published on GitHub
Only moves items to the Trash; Undo restores the last clean
Duplicate detection protects files referenced by project scripts
caveats: Not notarized by Apple yet, so the first launch needs manual approval in System Settings
Requires macOS 14 or later; a Windows version is only in development with no release date
Full Disk Access is optional and needed to measure Mail, Messages and Library
